总追踪：#4 · 稳定工作包：**C07** · 初始盘点基线：`d4b612b`（开工以实际最新 main／父 PR 为准）。

## Why／目标
真实远程文件/执行与SSH身份，公钥指纹可查看；找回现有seat并验证进程/任务身份，处理结构化问答与现有TUI。

## 当前已具备与真实差距
Tmux capture/属性与观察已有；远端SSH有未合入候选，seat lease/结构化会话接线未完整。

这是接续任务，不要求重写已有代码。未合入候选由主控发布可取的 checkpoint 后复用；若候选尚不可取，先推进接口、独立实现或相邻可做项，不等待原作者在线。代码路径及实际候选会随后写入任务清单。

## 依赖与 stacked PR
Depends on: #6 (C01), #8 (C03)

上述是**语义依赖**，不要求全部排成一个线性分支。若实际改动依赖某个未合并 PR，以该 PR 分支为 base，明确父 PR；若独立则 base main。父合并后当前整合者及时调整子 PR base。不得用多个全量重复 diff 冒充 stacked PR；没有真实补丁不造空 PR。

## 必读合同与范围
- 完整 SPEC 章节：**[§11](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/remote-seats.md#spec-11)、[§17](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/remote-seats.md#spec-17)、[§35.5](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/remote-seats.md#spec-35-5)、[§41](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/architecture.md#spec-41) seat合同**。
- 关联行为：B11, B15, B22, B24, B26, B35。
- 原始 R 主归属（不是将这些需求标成已完成）：
- **R016** Agent 按需要创建并维护自己的 SSH 身份密钥。
- **R017** 人类操作界面能展示和复制 Agent 的 SSH 公钥与指纹。
- **R018** SSH 可连接人类机器、未来完整容器及 Agent 自有节点。
- **R041** 用高质量 SSH 文件、执行和 memory 工具减少本地模型的操作负担。
- **R069** 通过正式插件控制 SSH/其他 runtime 上的 Claude Code、omp、tmux 等 Agent seats。
- **R070** 能根据记忆找回已有远程任务与工作位，并现场确认身份和进度。
- **R071** 在既有授权内自主回答远程选项和 permission，不逐项等待人类。
- **R072** 不确定时按人格和情境主动寻找可达用户渠道，再继续原任务。
- 对照 `docs/requirements/acceptance-cases.json` 中对应章节／行为的适用 case，开工时列明具体 case IDs；不按困难排除正式范围。

## 本工作包的验收／交付
旧问题/退回shell不被盲输；控制器重启不重复任务；主机身份正确校验；已有Claude和OMP分别实测，不混同SDK接管。

PR 附实际候选 SHA、输入版本、命令／交互与退出码、证据位置、失败／恢复／取消相关结果；fixture不能当真实环境，长期观察不能加速伪造。范围较大时可自主继续拆 focused 子 PR，并把接口和依赖回写本 issue，不设人工拆分审批。

### 自主协作与离线接续
- 在评论留下基础 SHA、分支／PR、下一动作即可参与；认领不独占，不要求先获批准。已有上游权限直接使用；否则 fork。
- 朋友下线不阻塞主控继续：从最后已推 checkpoint 开 continuation 分支，保留作者／原提交，链接原 PR，不等交还或在线，不强推对方分支。
- 自主研究、调整方法、安装依赖、实现、验证、提交和持续更新；不新增设计签字、逐阶段审批、逐工具授权或等 review 才继续的 gate。
- 未知外部 effects 先对账，不能因为换 worker 就重发；失败和未验证如实记录。验证复用已有证据，同一连贯增量不新增十个或更多测试。
- 不承诺所有工作包同时运行：主控当前环境最多 1 条 workflow，实际构建／测试在受管开发容器内；朋友按自己机器容量安排。

## 目标与来源

用户 2026-10-27 请求：“可以给 shenko 加一个 oxr 插件用于它需要时进行大量文档解析工作”。**用户于 2026-10-29 明确更正：OXR 指 [SoMarkAI/OXR](https://github.com/SoMarkAI/OXR)（Optical Everything Recognition），不是 OCR 的笔误或泛指，也不是默认改用 Docling。** 本 issue 的 provider 接入与验收以该项目为目标；通用 `document.parse` 合同仅作为 Shenko 的可替换边界。

实现一个可选、可替换的 `document.parse` definition v1：主体按需委派，后台处理大量文档；原件、页级文字/版式与证据可回指，取消和重启可以续接。不把 OCR 引擎、Python、模型权重或“什么时候该解析”的业务判断塞进 kernel，不使所有节点都必须安装大模型。

调查基线：`fddf1180917b214a3a13aaf025d79f473c2fc05e`（2026-10-27 22:52 UTC fresh 回读）。开工再次核对实际 main/owner/PR。

## 首个交付切片

- 本地 CAS 引用的 PDF/PNG/JPEG；电子 PDF 文字、扫描页 OCR、明确的页范围。批次组合现有有界 children，不新增平行 job 数据库。
- 复用 `NativeTaskDefinition`、`NativeTaskHandlerPlugin`、TaskRecord、OperationRecord、CAS 与 T1/E1/T2；thought 只收到有界现有快照或异步状态，耐久接纳之后才报告 accepted/task_id。
- 页级结果包含原件 digest、原始页索引、文字/块、阅读顺序、可用时 bbox、表格结构引用、provider/代码/模型/参数版本与原始输出引用。坐标还原到原始页；不能还原则明确未知，不伪造 bbox/置信度。
- 页级 CAS checkpoint、部分成功/失败、预算受限并发、取消/恢复、去重和缓存。缓存绑定源内容、页、版本化闭包/配置/schema及权限scope；相同提交不重复创建任务，未知执行先对账而非盲重发。
- 已安装/可用/未知能力分别呈现，帮助与依赖绑定实际版本。外部文档仍是资料，不取得指令或执行权限。

**非目标**：重新实现 C01/C02/C03/C10；新建第二套 scheduler/ledger；主主体直接文件或任意代码工具；默认云 OCR/文档外传；将本机 Python wrapper 冒称 WASM 移植；在首片承诺 Office 全格式、手写、精确公式或跨页表格无损复刻。保留后续扩展，不以未覆盖项冒充已验收。

## 复用依赖与原 owner 边界

Depends on（语义）：#6 C01、#7 C02、#8 C03、#15 C10。22:52 回读四项均 open、assignee 为 `cyjin-yl`；本 issue 不接管它们或重新建立同职责子项。

- **#6**：现有 durable task/effect/CAS，页 checkpoint 的原子登记、epoch/revision fencing与崩溃接续。
- **#7**：现有 native child 派发/取消/结果投影的有界执行接线。插件线先不平行大改 `child.rs/dispatch.rs`；通过该 issue 协调窄接口。
- **#8**：原生 Cordis handler 生命周期、实际 readiness、卸载与在途旧实现保留。
- **#15**：可发现性、运行说明与统一依赖闭包；required/recommended 和 exact/abstract 两轴分离，代码依赖须版本化合同/ABI，不能靠 topic-only 或包已复制宣称能力 ready。

Git base 不强制串成一条链；独立合同基于 main，只有实际依赖某未合并补丁才基于其分支。实现前与现有 owner 对齐文件/接口和 checkpoint，保留其他候选与原作者。

### 已静态确认的派发阻塞链

在该精确 head 上：
1. [`child.rs:179–187`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/fddf1180917b214a3a13aaf025d79f473c2fc05e/crates/shenko-subject/src/child.rs#L179-L187) 持 `run_lock`，逐个 await `process`。
2. [`child.rs:366–375`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/fddf1180917b214a3a13aaf025d79f473c2fc05e/crates/shenko-subject/src/child.rs#L366-L375) await 完整 `handler.execute`。
3. [`dispatch.rs:16–29`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/fddf1180917b214a3a13aaf025d79f473c2fc05e/crates/shenko-subject/src/dispatch.rs#L16-L29) 在 `run_once` 返回后才读取 ready results。

所以直接把长批次解析放入一个 execute 会延后同一 dispatcher 后续候选与结果投影。这里是源码控制流结论，**没有运行复现或延迟数值**。[`main.rs:290–310`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/fddf1180917b214a3a13aaf025d79f473c2fc05e/bin/shenko/src/main.rs#L290-L310) 已将 dispatcher 放到独立 tokio task，因此不把它误说成 thought 直接同步等待。仍需与 #7 合作验证长工作不拖短 child/通知，不能仅因独立 task 就宣布批量非阻塞完成。

## 指定 Provider：SoMarkAI/OXR 与来源边界

首个目标是用户指定的 **[SoMarkAI/OXR](https://github.com/SoMarkAI/OXR)**。2026-10-29 回读的源码锚点：[`c1a1dcb312ee9f691404f127785510453c0d9350`](https://github.com/SoMarkAI/OXR/tree/c1a1dcb312ee9f691404f127785510453c0d9350)；[该版本 README](https://github.com/SoMarkAI/OXR/blob/c1a1dcb312ee9f691404f127785510453c0d9350/README.md)说明 OXR 将 PDF/文档图像转为 Markdown/JSON，并提供版式坐标，layout analysis 与 recognition/reading order 可分离。插件需要适配真实 OXR 输入、结果与运行边界，不能用模拟 block 或其他引擎输出冒充 OXR 接入。

该 README 的本地部署要求为 Linux、支持 BF16 的 NVIDIA GPU、兼容 CUDA 13.0 的驱动，模型下载/源码运行使用 Python 3.12；起步显存为单卡 24GB（低并发），长文档/高并发建议至少 48GB。模型入口为 [SoMarkAI/OXR-1.0](https://huggingface.co/SoMarkAI/OXR-1.0) 和 [ModelScope SoMark/OXR-1.0](https://modelscope.cn/models/SoMark/OXR-1.0)，包含独立 layout 模型。这些是上游声明，**不是当前 Shenko 部署已满足要求或已测性能的证据**；现有设备/推理后端的兼容性须实际核验，不能假定 CPU、V100 或任意现有服务都可直接运行。

具体代码/runtime/wheel/transitive dependencies、识别与 layout 权重版本/digest/下载大小及各自许可证仍须分别固定核验；不把原 Docling 候选的 MIT 结论沿用到 OXR。之前将 Docling 列为首个 provider 的登记已撤回；其他引擎只能是以后明确声明的可替换实现，不能替代本 issue 的 OXR 目标。

本轮仅更正登记并回读公开源码，未安装/运行 OXR、下载模型、切换现有推理服务或传输私有文档。OXR 的公开免费 API 不是默认后备，也不据此授权文档外传。首次第三方实测按既有用户规则绑定源码/依赖/模型、隔离环境、自有输入、CPU/GPU/磁盘预算与获准范围；默认本地、离线，无账号凭据，只有指定原件/模型只读和 scratch 可写。缺能力应如实报告，不自动拉权重或上传远程。

## 最小验收与证据

以下是交付判据，不是要求每片重写一大套测试；复用既有 child/store suites，新增验证仅解决实际风险。

- 自有合成电子+扫描中文文档（简单双栏/表格），核对原件/页码、文字与 bbox 回指，保留真实识别错误；当前两页文字 PDF 不能冒充混合扫描样本。
- 大批次受限并发时，同主体与无关短 child 持续推进，短结果正常投影；记录真实页速/峰值资源，不承诺未经实测的性能数。
- 重复提交去重；同页缓存命中，版本/有效配置或权限scope变化不混用结果。
- 取消停止新页并等待实际 worker 终止再释放容量；保留部分结果。页结果已 seal/登记前崩溃、restart 与迟到结果不丢事实、不恢复旧权限，不重发未知效果。
- 缺模型、损坏/加密/不支持文档明确失败或部分成功；离线不偷偷拉权重/外链，不上传私有材料，不把失败标为完成。

证据绑定 Shenko/插件/provider/model/配置/fixture 精确版本、命令、退出码、时间、实际结果与产物位置；区分结构测试、真实解析、恢复和模型行为。若增加模型可见引导/awareness，使用真实 Shenko Store/subject/provider/parser 的留出场景及启用/停用对照；未测单元不宣称有效。

## 当前状态：有通用本地合同候选，OXR 尚未编译、接线或实测

独立本地候选包括可选 `shenko-document` crate、请求/结果/checkpoint 类型与结构校验、页cache key、NativeTaskDefinition编码、三项未执行测试、自写文字PDF和模拟block；无 OXR provider runner、handler 激活或 dispatcher 改动；该通用候选不是 OXR 接入完成证据。

二版补丁 SHA256：`eb5b231340c754e3575e70402c1562678d324ae00165a2ad4f963a8eb68169b1`。仅用于识别尚未发布工件，不是 Git commit/公开可取checkpoint；正式交接必须补真实 PR/head，不要求其他贡献者猜本机路径。

已做：自写静态 TOML/JSON/PDF xref检查、diff-check与补丁反向应用检查。未做：Cargo build/test、resolver检查、OCR/renderer/model执行、性能/故障/真实模型验收。初稿独立review发现的digest大小写、ID类型、checkpoint结构检查及递归strict措辞已修正；测试仍未运行。不能凭此关闭完整插件或任何父工作包。

**问题（现状证据）**——三件器官都造好了，只差接线：

- store 有 [§12.5](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/durable-state.md#content-stream-journal) 的内容流日志（`crates/shenko-store/src/content_stream.rs`，chunk ≤4KiB、重复即幂等、冲突有类型、关闭后拒收），生产无一处使用。
- UI 有 `StreamSink`（`crates/shenko-ui/src/stream.rs`，先落盘再广播），但 `bin/shenko` 从不调用 `with_stream_sink`，UI 因此诚实报 `streaming: false`。
- 主体侧用的是非流式 `submit_recorded`（`crates/shenko-subject/src/loop_runner.rs:1362`）。

**要做**
1. 实现 store 支撑的 `StreamJournalSink`（open/append_batch/append_terminal/close_stream），沿用 content_stream 的既有不变量。
2. 实现 `PublicStreamSink`：把 `PublicTextChunk` 映射成 UI 的 `OutputPart` 交给 `StreamSink::publish`；控制行由 broker 的 `ControlGate` 负责，不重复实现。
3. 给 `submit_stream` 一个 receipt sink（或新增 `submit_streamed_recorded`），让调用方照常拿到终态结果；不改 `submit_recorded` 语义。
4. 主体在没有流式 sink 时退回原路径（逐字节相同的现有行为）；有 sink 时走流式，最终正文仍由既有 S1 提交路径产生——流式是额外的有序表面，不替代 committed-only 发布。
5. `bin/shenko` 接线 `with_stream_sink`；没有生产者时 UI 继续诚实报 `streaming:false`，不做假打字机。

**这不是本轮改动引入的**：在本轮 [§57](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/architecture.md#spec-57) 弧线**之前**的基线（`9fc421d`，PR #238 的父提交）上跑同一条用例，同样挂起。本轮修掉的三个跨 crate 的冻结 schema 读法（PR #261）之后，这条用例仍然挂起。

**已经证明的部分（不是猜测）**
- 孩子的第一次运行**是对的**：结果里 `outcome=succeeded`、`termination=needs_decision`、`question=要观察哪个数据集？`、`steps=1`，假模型服务器也确实收到了请求并发出了回应，第一条 wire 到达了测试。
- 也就是说：**主体向孩子提问 → 孩子以一个耐久决定结束 → 主人读到这个提问** 这一段是通的；挂起发生在**之后的重开与继续**那段。

**排除掉的假设（都做过实验）**
1. 不是发布目标迁移：把迁移整个跳过（`Store::open` 里不调 `migrate_publication_targets`）后**照样挂**。
2. 不是被 abort 的 broker 留下的写事务：把测试里的 `run.abort()` 去掉后**照样挂**。
3. 不是"重开后旧 store 的连接占着 SQLite 写锁"：store 的每条连接都设了 `PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000`（`configure_sqlite`），一个真正被占的写锁会在 5 秒后**报错**而不是无限等待；挂起时进程里没有任何线程在 SQLite 调用里（一个 futex 等待 + 三个空闲的 tokio worker + 一个 epoll）。

**目前定位到的位置（插桩观测）**：在一次插桩运行里，最后一个标记是 `disp_before_commit` —— 即 `start_subject_dispatcher` 的事务已经走到提交那一步，**提交本身没有返回**。同一批插桩里，重开后的 store 的 `Store::open` 打印了 `store_before_migration` 但**没有**打印之后的测试阶段标记。插桩本身改过源码、边界标记不精确，所以这两条只能作为线索，不能当作结论。

**影响**
- `cargo test -p shenko-subject` **永远跑不完**（harness 在等这条用例）→ CI 无法区分"绿"和"红" —— 这是这件事真正严重的地方。
- 其余 110 条用例**都是绿的**（0 failed），挂起的是唯一一条。

**下一步（留给下一轮）**
1. 把这条用例的等待**变成有界的**（用 tokio 的 timeout 包住它）：这样整套用例能跑完、并如实报出这条是红的，而不是把整套挂住 —— 挂起比红更难查。
2. 继续定位：需要能在挂起时拿到 Rust 栈（容器里没有 gdb；`rust-gdb` 在但 `gdb` 本体没装）→ 装一个 gdb 或者在 store 的写路径上加"提交前后的标记"再收窄。
3. 重点怀疑对象：`start_subject_dispatcher` 的提交路径上，有另一条路径在没有持有 ledger 的 `conn` 互斥量的情况下使用了同一条 SQLite 连接（那样两个线程会在同一条连接上互相等）—— 这条假设还没有被实验验证。

**相关**：SPEC [§21.8](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/web-interface.md#spec-21-8)（动作与状态闭环）、[§52](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/channels.md#spec-52)（孩子的有限运行）、[§57](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/architecture.md#spec-57)（本轮弧线）。

issue tracks every place the Web UI works around Proto-UI, so each workaround can be removed once upstream is fixed. Upstream is `Proto-UI/Proto-UI` at `35195a6`, the same commit as our pin.

Every item was reproduced in Chromium (Playwright) against that commit. Code references point at `8a3f2fa` on `claude/shenko-ui-redesign-qqgizc` (PR #293).

**Upstream mapping updated 2026-11-13:** the earlier integration's 403 is historical. The authorized GitHub connector has now filed/updated the issues below and read back their exact bodies. U5 reuses the existing #732 queue; U6's semantic capability debt reuses #902 and its bounded diagnostic/admission-table follow-up is #1457. No upstream implementation is claimed fixed by filing.

## Workarounds in Shenko

### 1. Props-driven text in compiled Prototypes — fixed properly; no workaround remains (upstream U1)
- **Cause.** Under Proto-UI C-PROPS-0014, a props change does not imply a render. The runtime React adapter defaults to `autoUpdateOnPropsChange`, which hides this; the compiled `react-dom-source-v1` output does not. Our transport badge therefore showed 连接中 while the connection was up.
- **Was:** a `key={label}` remount.
- **Now:** the Prototype follows the contract. [`transport-badge.proto.ts#L26`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/prototypes/transport-badge.proto.ts#L26) calls `def.props.watch(['label'], (run) => run.update())`.
- **Rule for future Prototypes.** Any Prototype whose template reads a prop must watch that prop and call `update()`. `message-bubble` puts its content in the slot, so it is unaffected.

### 2. Icon-only buttons have no accessible-name prop; host attributes are dropped (upstream U2)
- **Button names.** [`ui-kit.tsx#L92`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/ui-kit.tsx#L92): `Button` puts its `label` into a visually hidden `<span>`. `aria-label` and `title` never reach the DOM.
- **Pressed state.** `aria-pressed` is also dropped, so pressed state moved to the upstream `toggle` family ([`ui-kit.tsx#L106`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/ui-kit.tsx#L106)).
- **`data-*` hooks.** They are dropped on Prototype roots and only `className` is forwarded. `.lens-item[data-source="work"]` therefore never matched, and IM rows never received `data-kind`. Both were fixed in 8a3f2fa by using classes instead:
  - [`im.tsx#L45`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/im.tsx#L45) (`kind-*`)
  - [`react-renderer.tsx#L241`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/react-renderer.tsx#L241) (`source-*`)
- **Remove when** Button, Toggle and ToggleGroup item gain an `a11yLabel`/`ariaLabel` and a documented host-attribute channel.

### 3. Icon buttons have no tooltips (upstream U3)
The tooltip trigger is itself focusable, and `asChild` is unsupported. Wrapping a Button gives two tab stops for one control, so Tooltip was not adopted.
**Remove when** a trigger can delegate to its child control.

### 4. Drawer geometry (upstream U4)
- **Fixed width.** The details sheet stays at the hard-coded `min(20rem, available)` width. `maxExtent` has no effect for left/right drawers, and a CSS width moves the sheet off-screen.
- **Root in the layout.** The drawer root takes part in the shell's grid, so we pin it out of flow at [`app.css#L603`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/app.css#L603).
- **Style overrides.** We strip the default boxes from collapsible triggers and content ([`app.css#L628-L642`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/app.css#L628-L642)). This is a design choice, not a bug.
- **Remove when** horizontal drawer extent becomes a prop and the root stays out of layout.

### 5. The compiler can only carry leaf Prototypes (upstream U5, U6)
- **What we compile.** Only `transport-badge` and `message-bubble` are Shenko Prototypes compiled by the Proto-UI compiler.
- **Why the rest stays React.** Everything that would compose official families stays as React over the adapter: a compiled Prototype cannot import `@proto.ui/prototypes-shadcn/*` or `@proto.ui/prototypes-base/*`. The expression subset also rules out ternaries in templates and array props (lists), so the message list and thread list cannot become compiled Prototypes.
- **Measured.** 0 of 216 shadcn files and 5 of 178 base files compile with any source profile.
- **Revisit when** workspace package imports and array props are admitted.

### 6. Consuming the compiler requires vendoring its source (upstream U7)
- **Vendored compiler.** `@proto.ui/compiler` is private and source-only. [`compiler.mjs`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/compiler.mjs#L178) audits its package and source digest, then bundles its TypeScript with our own esbuild.
- **Full source checkout.** The build needs `PROTO_UI_SOURCE` pointing at a checkout of the exact pin ([`build.mjs#L28`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/build.mjs#L28)), plus building the 42-package public closure in order to use 4 shadcn family entry points.
- **Remove when** upstream publishes a compiler build or CLI with a pinned profile.

## Shenko's own debt (not upstream)

### 7. 95 `!important` declarations in `app.css`
Proto-UI's token CSS is entirely inside `@layer proto-ui`, so unlayered rules already win and no `!important` should be needed against upstream. The ones we have exist because our own rules override each other: the Buttons section (`.sk-button-*`) is overridden by more specific contexts such as `.entry-tools .sk-button` and `.composer-im .send`.

Pixel comparison with a fixed clock, 9 views, one section at a time:
- **Removable now:** the `!important`s in the Shell, Buttons, Attachments, On-demand pages and Details drawer sections. Each was removed alone and every screenshot stayed byte-identical.
- **Need reordering or specificity first:** Stage, Empty, Composer, Narrow, Views and Inspect, plus two rules in the preamble.
- **Removing them all at once changes 7 of 9 views.** For example, the closed drawer sheet appears at the bottom of the screen.

Plan: remove them section by section, re-run the screenshot diff after each step, and fix the ordering where a diff appears.

is a taste review of Shenko at `main` `502d677` plus PR #293 (`c0497fb`), held to the same standard as the Proto-UI compiler audit (#295). Each item gives the evidence, the best-practice fix, and the shortcuts that would turn the check green without fixing the problem.

Several items are my own debt from the UI redesign, and they are marked **(own)**. One was fixed while writing this (T13).

## A. Engineering hygiene

**T1 — There is no CI at all (P0).**
- **Evidence.** `.github/` contains only `pull_request_template.md`. #291 merged with zero automated checks; every verification so far ran locally in an agent session.
- **Best practice.** Required GitHub Actions on every PR:
  - `cargo check`/`cargo test` for the workspace (or the affected crates);
  - a clippy warnings ratchet;
  - `python3 scripts/check_docs.py` and `python3 scripts/check_kernel_boundary.py --baseline-ref <base>`;
  - for the web UI: `tsc --noEmit`, `node --test`, and a rebuild that proves the committed `src/static/*` matches the digests in `build-manifest.json` (see T4).

  The checks should be cheap enough to finish in minutes; run long suites nightly.
- **Rejected.**
  - Treating "an agent ran it locally" as the gate.
  - Marking slow tests `#[ignore]` so CI passes.
  - Making the workflow non-blocking.

**T2 — 124 compiler warnings are tolerated.**
- **Evidence.** `cargo check --workspace` reports 124 warnings. The largest counts are in exec-host (22), store (13), wasm (8) and subject (8), and include unused imports and variables.
- **Best practice.** Clear them, then enforce `-D warnings` in CI. Until then, ratchet the count down.
- **Rejected.** `#[allow(warnings)]`; `_`-prefixing variables without checking whether the value matters.

**T3 — 313 `unwrap()`/`expect()` in production code** (counting code before `#[cfg(test)]`).
- **Evidence.** The heaviest files are `exec-ssh/identity.rs` (27), `broker/broker.rs` (20) and `exec-ssh/executor.rs` (17). There are also 67 `panic!`/`todo!`/`unimplemented!`.
- **Best practice.**
  - Use typed errors on every path that touches I/O, external input or recovery.
  - `expect` only for proven invariants, with a message that names the invariant.
  - Add a `clippy::unwrap_used` ratchet for non-test code.
- **Rejected.** A global search-and-replace of `unwrap()` → `expect("unwrap")`.

**T4 — Committed build artifacts have no freshness check, and the build is hard to reproduce.**
- **Evidence.**
  - The minified `app.js`/CSS live in git and are embedded with `include_str!`.
  - Rebuilding requires `PROTO_UI_SOURCE` (a local checkout of the exact Proto-UI commit), building its 42-package public closure, and Node 24.
  - Nothing verifies that the committed bundle matches `web/src`.
- **Best practice.**
  - Keep the embedding (no Node needed at runtime), but have CI rebuild and compare against the manifest digests.
  - Pin the toolchain in the repo (Node version file, `packageManager`).
  - Consume Proto-UI through a pinned, published artifact instead of a local checkout.
- **Rejected.** Hand-editing `app.js`; dropping the digest check because a rebuild differs.

## B. Documents and references

**T5 — Line numbers are used as identity.**
- **Evidence.**
  - `docs/state/coverage.json` holds 94 code references of the form `file:line`.
  - `docs/requirements/acceptance-cases.json` holds 472 `source_markdown_line` entries, and `check_docs.py` requires the exact `source_row` text at that line.
  - Any edit above a referenced line breaks them. In #291/#293 the acceptance index and coverage lines had to be re-pointed three times.
- **Best practice.** Reference stable identities instead:
  - explicit anchors (the specs already use `<a id="…">`), with case ids kept in the row itself;
  - symbol references (`path#Symbol`) that tooling resolves.

  The check then verifies that the anchor or symbol exists, not which line it sits on.
- **Rejected (I did this).** Scripts that rewrite line numbers after every edit. They keep the check green while the references stop meaning anything.

**T6 — Document volume and mandatory reading.**
- **Evidence.**
  - 4.1 MB of current Markdown, outside `docs/history`. `cognition-units.md` alone is 120 KB.
  - Mandatory reading before any change is `CLAUDE.md` (18.7 KB) plus the `shenko-dev` Skill (19.7 KB).
  - The specs carry 656 `migrated-contract` markers.
  - Provenance lives in two archives: `docs/history` and `docs/research/archive` (about 1.2 MB of old specs).
- **Best practice.**
  - Contracts stay short and why-first, with details in referenced appendices.
  - Mandatory reading is a few KB that links outward.
  - Provenance lives in one archive location.
- **Rejected.** Shrinking by deleting obligations or user words. The identity-preservation rule stands: compress the structure, not the requirements.

**T7 — Code comments cite specs 1,597 times (`docs/specs/…#spec-…`).**
- **Evidence.** Inline citations act as a compliance trail rather than an explanation. They hurt readability and break when anchors move.
- **Best practice.** A comment explains the local why. The spec ↔ code trace lives in one place (coverage), keyed by symbol (T5).
- **Rejected.** Mass-deleting the citations before the trace has moved into coverage.

## C. Structure

**T8 — Giant files.**
- **Evidence.**
  - `shenko-node/src/units.rs` has 9,826 lines.
  - `bin/shenko/src/lib.rs` has 7,473 lines: all binary wiring in one library file.
  - `shenko-store/src/cognition.rs` has 6,768 lines.
  - `web/src/live-controller.ts` has 2,166 lines in a single class mixing transport, state, resource loaders and persistence.
  - `react-renderer.tsx` has 1,319 lines **(own)**.
- **Best practice.** Split along responsibilities that match contract boundaries. For the controller: socket transport, state reducer, read-model loaders, preferences.
- **Rejected.** Mechanical `part1`/`part2` splits; re-exporting barrels that hide the same coupling.

## D. UI debts (mostly own)

**T9 — The UI hard-codes plugin task kinds (own).**
- **Evidence.** [`threads.ts#L187`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/c0497fb/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/threads.ts#L187) checks `DELEGATION_KINDS = {'model.child'}`, and [`react-renderer.tsx#L337`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/c0497fb/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/react-renderer.tsx#L337) checks `kind !== 'subject_root'`. A surface should not depend on specific plugins (spirit of kernel 7).
- **Best practice.** The task row carries a structural role derived from ledger facts (root / delegation / tool, from `TaskOwner` and the task contract or capability directory), and the UI keys on that role.
- **Rejected.** Adding each new child kind to the string set.

**T10 — The UI re-parses model output (own).**
- **Evidence.** [`threads.ts#L261`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/c0497fb/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/threads.ts#L261) strips `[tool:…]` and other control lines from child step text with a regex. That is a second parser living in the UI.
- **Best practice.** The step record stores the public display text separately from the parsed controls. The UI renders structured fields only.
- **Rejected.** Making the regex stricter.

**T11 — 95 `!important` in `app.css` (own).**
- **Evidence.** Proto-UI's token CSS is entirely inside `@layer proto-ui`, so these are not needed against upstream. They come from our own rules overriding each other.
  - A pixel diff with a fixed clock (9 views) shows that removing them all at once changes 7 views.
  - Removing a whole section at a time shows that 5 sections can drop theirs with byte-identical screenshots.
- **Best practice.** Remove them section by section with the screenshot harness, fixing ordering and specificity wherever a diff appears.
- **Rejected.** A global `sed`, which was measured to break the layout.

**T12 — UI strings are hard-coded in components.**
- **Evidence.** Chinese strings sit inline throughout the components, with no message catalog, although the compiler-migration gates in §21.2 include i18n regression.
- **Best practice.** A message catalog keyed by id. The projection carries ids, and the renderer resolves them.

**T13 — Two task-row readers (own) — fixed in c0497fb.**
- **Evidence.** `list_recent_tasks` and `list_task_summaries` coexisted.
- **Fix.** The three callers moved to `list_task_summaries`, and the old reader and `RecentTask` were deleted, per the rule to migrate callers and delete superseded paths.

**T14 — Demo fixtures ship inside product modules (own).**
- **Evidence.** `demoTrajectory` sits in `threads.ts` and the demo conversations in `react-renderer.tsx`, all inside the production bundle.
- **Best practice.** Put demo fixtures in a separate module that is loaded only for `?demo=1` (dynamic import).

## Suggested order

1. T1 (CI), with T4 folded in.
2. T5 (stable references): it removes the most churn per change.
3. T2 and T3 as ratchets.

C19's long-running evidence recorder already fsyncs each record and rejects corrupted/extended seals, but independent `sample`, `run`, `checkpoint`, and `stop` CLI processes can simultaneously read the same last sequence and append contradictory records. 总追踪：#4 · 稳定工作包：**C07** · 初始盘点基线：`d4b612b`（开工以实际最新 main／父 PR 为准）。

## Why／目标
真实远程文件/执行与SSH身份，公钥指纹可查看；找回现有seat并验证进程/任务身份，处理结构化问答与现有TUI。

## 当前已具备与真实差距
Tmux capture/属性与观察已有；远端SSH有未合入候选，seat lease/结构化会话接线未完整。

这是接续任务，不要求重写已有代码。未合入候选由主控发布可取的 checkpoint 后复用；若候选尚不可取，先推进接口、独立实现或相邻可做项，不等待原作者在线。代码路径及实际候选会随后写入任务清单。

## 依赖与 stacked PR
Depends on: #6 (C01), #8 (C03)

上述是**语义依赖**，不要求全部排成一个线性分支。若实际改动依赖某个未合并 PR，以该 PR 分支为 base，明确父 PR；若独立则 base main。父合并后当前整合者及时调整子 PR base。不得用多个全量重复 diff 冒充 stacked PR；没有真实补丁不造空 PR。

## 必读合同与范围
- 完整 SPEC 章节：**[§11](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/remote-seats.md#spec-11)、[§17](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/remote-seats.md#spec-17)、[§35.5](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/remote-seats.md#spec-35-5)、[§41](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/architecture.md#spec-41) seat合同**。
- 关联行为：B11, B15, B22, B24, B26, B35。
- 原始 R 主归属（不是将这些需求标成已完成）：
- **R016** Agent 按需要创建并维护自己的 SSH 身份密钥。
- **R017** 人类操作界面能展示和复制 Agent 的 SSH 公钥与指纹。
- **R018** SSH 可连接人类机器、未来完整容器及 Agent 自有节点。
- **R041** 用高质量 SSH 文件、执行和 memory 工具减少本地模型的操作负担。
- **R069** 通过正式插件控制 SSH/其他 runtime 上的 Claude Code、omp、tmux 等 Agent seats。
- **R070** 能根据记忆找回已有远程任务与工作位，并现场确认身份和进度。
- **R071** 在既有授权内自主回答远程选项和 permission，不逐项等待人类。
- **R072** 不确定时按人格和情境主动寻找可达用户渠道，再继续原任务。
- 对照 `docs/requirements/acceptance-cases.json` 中对应章节／行为的适用 case，开工时列明具体 case IDs；不按困难排除正式范围。

## 本工作包的验收／交付
旧问题/退回shell不被盲输；控制器重启不重复任务；主机身份正确校验；已有Claude和OMP分别实测，不混同SDK接管。

PR 附实际候选 SHA、输入版本、命令／交互与退出码、证据位置、失败／恢复／取消相关结果；fixture不能当真实环境，长期观察不能加速伪造。范围较大时可自主继续拆 focused 子 PR，并把接口和依赖回写本 issue，不设人工拆分审批。

### 自主协作与离线接续
- 在评论留下基础 SHA、分支／PR、下一动作即可参与；认领不独占，不要求先获批准。已有上游权限直接使用；否则 fork。
- 朋友下线不阻塞主控继续：从最后已推 checkpoint 开 continuation 分支，保留作者／原提交，链接原 PR，不等交还或在线，不强推对方分支。
- 自主研究、调整方法、安装依赖、实现、验证、提交和持续更新；不新增设计签字、逐阶段审批、逐工具授权或等 review 才继续的 gate。
- 未知外部 effects 先对账，不能因为换 worker 就重发；失败和未验证如实记录。验证复用已有证据，同一连贯增量不新增十个或更多测试。
- 不承诺所有工作包同时运行：主控当前环境最多 1 条 workflow，实际构建／测试在受管开发容器内；朋友按自己机器容量安排。

### 可复制的任务 GOAL／PROMPT
> 加入 cyjin-yl/shenko 的当前开发栈，完成本 issue 的行为切片，不重新从零构建整个产品。先读取 AGENTS.md、.agents/skills/shenko-dev/SKILL.md、WHY.md、GOAL.md、docs/governance/COMPLETION.md，以及本 issue 指定的完整 SPEC 章节和关联 R/B/case。核对实际 main/父 PR/候选 SHA 和未提交工作，优先复用已有实现。按真实依赖选择基础分支，建立隔离工作树；自主实现和调试，记录重要决定的 Why，使用少量直接有用的验证，准确区分构建、模拟、真实运行。尽早 commit、push 并开有实际差异的 draft PR；列出对应 issue、Depends on、真实 base/head 和证据。父 PR 未合并时继续构建子 PR或独立工作，不等人类批准。每次下线前推送 checkpoint，留下下一动作、剩余问题和实际资源／effect 状态。局部任务完成不等于完整 S1–S5 goal 完成。
## 已合入的仓库任务卡

[docs/tasks/C07.md](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/c017917d9da3f6959943be95bafa3e1893f48b9a/docs/history/task-cards-20261101/C07.md) 已随 PR #27 合入。当前从 [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/AGENTS.md) 与 [docs/INDEX.md](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/INDEX.md) 加入开发；本 issue 仍为待交付产品工作，不因文档合入而关闭。


现行阅读入口（2026-11-11 文档迁移）：按 [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/AGENTS.md)、[文档索引](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/INDEX.md)及本 issue 上述具体领域合同接续；[开发合同](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/governance/development-contract.md)与[完整交付合同](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/governance/COMPLETION.md)说明自主性与验收。上面的引用原文、初始基线、任务完成记录及归档链接保留历史事实，不作为现行开工指令；并发按实际容量安排，旧卡片的固定 workflow 数量不再适用。


Seat 问题、决定与答复的具体合同见 [远端 Seat 合同](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/remote-seats.md#spec-41-11)。

## 目标与来源

实现一个可选、可替换的 `document.parse` definition v1：主体按需委派，后台处理大量文档；原件、页级文字/版式与证据可回指，取消和重启可以续接。不把 OCR 引擎、Python、模型权重或“什么时候该解析”的业务判断塞进 kernel，不使所有节点都必须安装大模型。

调查基线：`fddf1180917b214a3a13aaf025d79f473c2fc05e`（2026-10-27 22:52 UTC fresh 回读）。开工再次核对实际 main/owner/PR。

### 已静态确认的派发阻塞链

在该精确 head 上：
1. [`child.rs:179–187`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/fddf1180917b214a3a13aaf025d79f473c2fc05e/crates/shenko-subject/src/child.rs#L179-L187) 持 `run_lock`，逐个 await `process`。

## 指定 Provider：SoMarkAI/OXR 与来源边界

首个目标是用户指定的 **[SoMarkAI/OXR](https://github.com/SoMarkAI/OXR)**。2026-10-29 回读的源码锚点：[`c1a1dcb312ee9f691404f127785510453c0d9350`](https://github.com/SoMarkAI/OXR/tree/c1a1dcb312ee9f691404f127785510453c0d9350)；[该版本 README](https://github.com/SoMarkAI/OXR/blob/c1a1dcb312ee9f691404f127785510453c0d9350/README.md)说明 OXR 将 PDF/文档图像转为 Markdown/JSON，并提供版式坐标，layout analysis 与 recognition/reading order 可分离。插件需要适配真实 OXR 输入、结果与运行边界，不能用模拟 block 或其他引擎输出冒充 OXR 接入。

该 README 的本地部署要求为 Linux、支持 BF16 的 NVIDIA GPU、兼容 CUDA 13.0 的驱动，模型下载/源码运行使用 Python 3.12；起步显存为单卡 24GB（低并发），长文档/高并发建议至少 48GB。模型入口为 [SoMarkAI/OXR-1.0](https://huggingface.co/SoMarkAI/OXR-1.0) 和 [ModelScope SoMark/OXR-1.0](https://modelscope.cn/models/SoMark/OXR-1.0)，包含独立 layout 模型。这些是上游声明，**不是当前 Shenko 部署已满足要求或已测性能的证据**；现有设备/推理后端的兼容性须实际核验，不能假定 CPU、V100 或任意现有服务都可直接运行。

具体代码/runtime/wheel/transitive dependencies、识别与 layout 权重版本/digest/下载大小及各自许可证仍须分别固定核验；不把原 Docling 候选的 MIT 结论沿用到 OXR。之前将 Docling 列为首个 provider 的登记已撤回；其他引擎只能是以后明确声明的可替换实现，不能替代本 issue 的 OXR 目标。

本轮仅更正登记并回读公开源码，未安装/运行 OXR、下载模型、切换现有推理服务或传输私有文档。OXR 的公开免费 API 不是默认后备，也不据此授权文档外传。首次第三方实测按既有用户规则绑定源码/依赖/模型、隔离环境、自有输入、CPU/GPU/磁盘预算与获准范围；默认本地、离线，无账号凭据，只有指定原件/模型只读和 scratch 可写。缺能力应如实报告，不自动拉权重或上传远程。

**这不是本轮改动引入的**：在本轮 [§57](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/main/docs/specs/architecture.md#spec-57) 弧线**之前**的基线（`9fc421d`，PR #238 的父提交）上跑同一条用例，同样挂起。本轮修掉的三个跨 crate 的冻结 schema 读法（PR #261）之后，这条用例仍然挂起。

**已经证明的部分（不是猜测）**
- 孩子的第一次运行**是对的**：结果里 `outcome=succeeded`、`termination=needs_decision`、`question=要观察哪个数据集？`、`steps=1`，假模型服务器也确实收到了请求并发出了回应，第一条 wire 到达了测试。
- 也就是说：**主体向孩子提问 → 孩子以一个耐久决定结束 → 主人读到这个提问** 这一段是通的；挂起发生在**之后的重开与继续**那段。

**排除掉的假设（都做过实验）**
1. 不是发布目标迁移：把迁移整个跳过（`Store::open` 里不调 `migrate_publication_targets`）后**照样挂**。
2. 不是被 abort 的 broker 留下的写事务：把测试里的 `run.abort()` 去掉后**照样挂**。
3. 不是"重开后旧 store 的连接占着 SQLite 写锁"：store 的每条连接都设了 `PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000`（`configure_sqlite`），一个真正被占的写锁会在 5 秒后**报错**而不是无限等待；挂起时进程里没有任何线程在 SQLite 调用里（一个 futex 等待 + 三个空闲的 tokio worker + 一个 epoll）。

**目前定位到的位置（插桩观测）**：在一次插桩运行里，最后一个标记是 `disp_before_commit` —— 即 `start_subject_dispatcher` 的事务已经走到提交那一步，**提交本身没有返回**。同一批插桩里，重开后的 store 的 `Store::open` 打印了 `store_before_migration` 但**没有**打印之后的测试阶段标记。插桩本身改过源码、边界标记不精确，所以这两条只能作为线索，不能当作结论。

**影响**
- `cargo test -p shenko-subject` **永远跑不完**（harness 在等这条用例）→ CI 无法区分"绿"和"红" —— 这是这件事真正严重的地方。
- 其余 110 条用例**都是绿的**（0 failed），挂起的是唯一一条。

issue tracks every place the Web UI works around Proto-UI, so each workaround can be removed once upstream is fixed. Upstream is `Proto-UI/Proto-UI` at `35195a6`, the same commit as our pin.

Every item was reproduced in Chromium (Playwright) against that commit. Code references point at `8a3f2fa` on `claude/shenko-ui-redesign-qqgizc` (PR #293).

**Upstream mapping updated 2026-11-13:** the earlier integration's 403 is historical. The authorized GitHub connector has now filed/updated the issues below and read back their exact bodies. U5 reuses the existing #732 queue; U6's semantic capability debt reuses #902 and its bounded diagnostic/admission-table follow-up is #1457. No upstream implementation is claimed fixed by filing.

## Workarounds in Shenko

### 1. Props-driven text in compiled Prototypes — fixed properly; no workaround remains (upstream U1)
- **Cause.** Under Proto-UI C-PROPS-0014, a props change does not imply a render. The runtime React adapter defaults to `autoUpdateOnPropsChange`, which hides this; the compiled `react-dom-source-v1` output does not. Our transport badge therefore showed 连接中 while the connection was up.
- **Was:** a `key={label}` remount.
- **Now:** the Prototype follows the contract. [`transport-badge.proto.ts#L26`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/prototypes/transport-badge.proto.ts#L26) calls `def.props.watch(['label'], (run) => run.update())`.
- **Rule for future Prototypes.** Any Prototype whose template reads a prop must watch that prop and call `update()`. `message-bubble` puts its content in the slot, so it is unaffected.

### 2. Icon-only buttons have no accessible-name prop; host attributes are dropped (upstream U2)
- **Button names.** [`ui-kit.tsx#L92`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/ui-kit.tsx#L92): `Button` puts its `label` into a visually hidden `<span>`. `aria-label` and `title` never reach the DOM.
- **Pressed state.** `aria-pressed` is also dropped, so pressed state moved to the upstream `toggle` family ([`ui-kit.tsx#L106`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/ui-kit.tsx#L106)).
- **`data-*` hooks.** They are dropped on Prototype roots and only `className` is forwarded. `.lens-item[data-source="work"]` therefore never matched, and IM rows never received `data-kind`. Both were fixed in 8a3f2fa by using classes instead:
  - [`im.tsx#L45`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/im.tsx#L45) (`kind-*`)
  - [`react-renderer.tsx#L241`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/react-renderer.tsx#L241) (`source-*`)
- **Remove when** Button, Toggle and ToggleGroup item gain an `a11yLabel`/`ariaLabel` and a documented host-attribute channel.

### 3. Icon buttons have no tooltips (upstream U3)
The tooltip trigger is itself focusable, and `asChild` is unsupported. Wrapping a Button gives two tab stops for one control, so Tooltip was not adopted.
**Remove when** a trigger can delegate to its child control.

### 4. Drawer geometry (upstream U4)
- **Fixed width.** The details sheet stays at the hard-coded `min(20rem, available)` width. `maxExtent` has no effect for left/right drawers, and a CSS width moves the sheet off-screen.
- **Root in the layout.** The drawer root takes part in the shell's grid, so we pin it out of flow at [`app.css#L603`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/app.css#L603).
- **Style overrides.** We strip the default boxes from collapsible triggers and content ([`app.css#L628-L642`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/app.css#L628-L642)). This is a design choice, not a bug.
- **Remove when** horizontal drawer extent becomes a prop and the root stays out of layout.

### 5. The compiler can only carry leaf Prototypes (upstream U5, U6)
- **What we compile.** Only `transport-badge` and `message-bubble` are Shenko Prototypes compiled by the Proto-UI compiler.
- **Why the rest stays React.** Everything that would compose official families stays as React over the adapter: a compiled Prototype cannot import `@proto.ui/prototypes-shadcn/*` or `@proto.ui/prototypes-base/*`. The expression subset also rules out ternaries in templates and array props (lists), so the message list and thread list cannot become compiled Prototypes.
- **Measured.** 0 of 216 shadcn files and 5 of 178 base files compile with any source profile.
- **Revisit when** workspace package imports and array props are admitted.

### 6. Consuming the compiler requires vendoring its source (upstream U7)
- **Vendored compiler.** `@proto.ui/compiler` is private and source-only. [`compiler.mjs`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/compiler.mjs#L178) audits its package and source digest, then bundles its TypeScript with our own esbuild.
- **Full source checkout.** The build needs `PROTO_UI_SOURCE` pointing at a checkout of the exact pin ([`build.mjs#L28`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/8a3f2fa/crates/shenko-ui/web/build.mjs#L28)), plus building the 42-package public closure in order to use 4 shadcn family entry points.
- **Remove when** upstream publishes a compiler build or CLI with a pinned profile.

## Shenko's own debt (not upstream)

### 7. 95 `!important` declarations in `app.css`
Proto-UI's token CSS is entirely inside `@layer proto-ui`, so unlayered rules already win and no `!important` should be needed against upstream. The ones we have exist because our own rules override each other: the Buttons section (`.sk-button-*`) is overridden by more specific contexts such as `.entry-tools .sk-button` and `.composer-im .send`.

Pixel comparison with a fixed clock, 9 views, one section at a time:
- **Removable now:** the `!important`s in the Shell, Buttons, Attachments, On-demand pages and Details drawer sections. Each was removed alone and every screenshot stayed byte-identical.
- **Need reordering or specificity first:** Stage, Empty, Composer, Narrow, Views and Inspect, plus two rules in the preamble.
- **Removing them all at once changes 7 of 9 views.** For example, the closed drawer sheet appears at the bottom of the screen.

Plan: remove them section by section, re-run the screenshot diff after each step, and fix the ordering where a diff appears.

is a taste review of Shenko at `main` `502d677` plus PR #293 (`c0497fb`), held to the same standard as the Proto-UI compiler audit (#295). Each item gives the evidence, the best-practice fix, and the shortcuts that would turn the check green without fixing the problem.

Several items are my own debt from the UI redesign, and they are marked **(own)**. One was fixed while writing this (T13).

## A. Engineering hygiene

**T1 — There is no CI at all (P0).**
- **Evidence.** `.github/` contains only `pull_request_template.md`. #291 merged with zero automated checks; every verification so far ran locally in an agent session.
- **Best practice.** Required GitHub Actions on every PR:
  - `cargo check`/`cargo test` for the workspace (or the affected crates);
  - a clippy warnings ratchet;
  - `python3 scripts/check_docs.py` and `python3 scripts/check_kernel_boundary.py --baseline-ref <base>`;
  - for the web UI: `tsc --noEmit`, `node --test`, and a rebuild that proves the committed `src/static/*` matches the digests in `build-manifest.json` (see T4).

  The checks should be cheap enough to finish in minutes; run long suites nightly.
- **Rejected.**
  - Treating "an agent ran it locally" as the gate.
  - Marking slow tests `#[ignore]` so CI passes.
  - Making the workflow non-blocking.

**T2 — 124 compiler warnings are tolerated.**
- **Evidence.** `cargo check --workspace` reports 124 warnings. The largest counts are in exec-host (22), store (13), wasm (8) and subject (8), and include unused imports and variables.
- **Best practice.** Clear them, then enforce `-D warnings` in CI. Until then, ratchet the count down.
- **Rejected.** `#[allow(warnings)]`; `_`-prefixing variables without checking whether the value matters.

**T3 — 313 `unwrap()`/`expect()` in production code** (counting code before `#[cfg(test)]`).
- **Evidence.** The heaviest files are `exec-ssh/identity.rs` (27), `broker/broker.rs` (20) and `exec-ssh/executor.rs` (17). There are also 67 `panic!`/`todo!`/`unimplemented!`.
- **Best practice.**
  - Use typed errors on every path that touches I/O, external input or recovery.
  - `expect` only for proven invariants, with a message that names the invariant.
  - Add a `clippy::unwrap_used` ratchet for non-test code.
- **Rejected.** A global search-and-replace of `unwrap()` → `expect("unwrap")`.

**T4 — Committed build artifacts have no freshness check, and the build is hard to reproduce.**
- **Evidence.**
  - The minified `app.js`/CSS live in git and are embedded with `include_str!`.
  - Rebuilding requires `PROTO_UI_SOURCE` (a local checkout of the exact Proto-UI commit), building its 42-package public closure, and Node 24.
  - Nothing verifies that the committed bundle matches `web/src`.
- **Best practice.**
  - Keep the embedding (no Node needed at runtime), but have CI rebuild and compare against the manifest digests.
  - Pin the toolchain in the repo (Node version file, `packageManager`).
  - Consume Proto-UI through a pinned, published artifact instead of a local checkout.
- **Rejected.** Hand-editing `app.js`; dropping the digest check because a rebuild differs.

## B. Documents and references

**T5 — Line numbers are used as identity.**
- **Evidence.**
  - `docs/state/coverage.json` holds 94 code references of the form `file:line`.
  - `docs/requirements/acceptance-cases.json` holds 472 `source_markdown_line` entries, and `check_docs.py` requires the exact `source_row` text at that line.
  - Any edit above a referenced line breaks them. In #291/#293 the acceptance index and coverage lines had to be re-pointed three times.
- **Best practice.** Reference stable identities instead:
  - explicit anchors (the specs already use `<a id="…">`), with case ids kept in the row itself;
  - symbol references (`path#Symbol`) that tooling resolves.

  The check then verifies that the anchor or symbol exists, not which line it sits on.
- **Rejected (I did this).** Scripts that rewrite line numbers after every edit. They keep the check green while the references stop meaning anything.

**T6 — Document volume and mandatory reading.**
- **Evidence.**
  - 4.1 MB of current Markdown, outside `docs/history`. `cognition-units.md` alone is 120 KB.
  - Mandatory reading before any change is `CLAUDE.md` (18.7 KB) plus the `shenko-dev` Skill (19.7 KB).
  - The specs carry 656 `migrated-contract` markers.
  - Provenance lives in two archives: `docs/history` and `docs/research/archive` (about 1.2 MB of old specs).
- **Best practice.**
  - Contracts stay short and why-first, with details in referenced appendices.
  - Mandatory reading is a few KB that links outward.
  - Provenance lives in one archive location.
- **Rejected.** Shrinking by deleting obligations or user words. The identity-preservation rule stands: compress the structure, not the requirements.

**T7 — Code comments cite specs 1,597 times (`docs/specs/…#spec-…`).**
- **Evidence.** Inline citations act as a compliance trail rather than an explanation. They hurt readability and break when anchors move.
- **Best practice.** A comment explains the local why. The spec ↔ code trace lives in one place (coverage), keyed by symbol (T5).
- **Rejected.** Mass-deleting the citations before the trace has moved into coverage.

## C. Structure

**T8 — Giant files.**
- **Evidence.**
  - `shenko-node/src/units.rs` has 9,826 lines.
  - `bin/shenko/src/lib.rs` has 7,473 lines: all binary wiring in one library file.
  - `shenko-store/src/cognition.rs` has 6,768 lines.
  - `web/src/live-controller.ts` has 2,166 lines in a single class mixing transport, state, resource loaders and persistence.
  - `react-renderer.tsx` has 1,319 lines **(own)**.
- **Best practice.** Split along responsibilities that match contract boundaries. For the controller: socket transport, state reducer, read-model loaders, preferences.
- **Rejected.** Mechanical `part1`/`part2` splits; re-exporting barrels that hide the same coupling.

## D. UI debts (mostly own)

**T9 — The UI hard-codes plugin task kinds (own).**
- **Evidence.** [`threads.ts#L187`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/c0497fb/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/threads.ts#L187) checks `DELEGATION_KINDS = {'model.child'}`, and [`react-renderer.tsx#L337`](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/c0497fb/crates/shenko-ui/web/src/react-renderer.tsx#L337) checks `kind !== 'subject_root'`. A surface should not depend on specific plugins (spirit of kernel 7).
- **Best practice.** The task row carries a structural role derived from ledger facts (root / delegation / tool, from `TaskOwner` and the task contract or capability directory), and the UI keys on that role.

- Validate owned, private, regular, single-link lock inode, refuse symlink/hard-link substitution and verify the opened inode still matches the directory entry. Persist the lock entry. Never unlink the lock on command exit.

- Add **five** distinct independent-process/file scenarios (20 total) covering competing samplers, racing stop/sample, racing initializers, substituted lock symlink, and serialized report snapshot. Why
C19's long-running evidence recorder already fsyncs each record and rejects corrupted/extended seals, but independent `sample`, `run`, `checkpoint`, and `stop` CLI processes can simultaneously read the same last sequence and append contradictory records. Atomic file append does **not** make the read–check–append transition atomic. That can lose a genuine observation or admit confusing evidence during the required candidate-bound 7/30-day run.

## Change
- Serialize `init`, individual `sample` transitions, `checkpoint`, `stop`, and reporting on the persistent Linux run-directory inode using `flock`. A long `run` releases between samples.
- Use a shared report lock for pure reads, an exclusive one for `report --write`; fail closed if the directory inode is replaced or cannot be locked.
- No sidecar lock file (which could be unlinked and silently split the lock), no modified record schema, weakened gaps, tolerance, evidence or wall-clock criteria.
- Add **two** real subprocess regression scenarios: concurrent writers retain exactly one header and ordered sample sequence; racing stop remains a terminal append barrier. Preserve all 15 original scenarios.

## Evidence and limits
- Exact base: `main@84ae19404f2a17d259362c99091db408b7262e14`, new commit `c69389f1f1106b9bb15f4157e7f1a0629806a270` (two files).
- Reviewed exact Git blob/tree hashes; independent local Linux `flock(dirfd)` probe serialized 24 child processes, **not** a Shenko product or full test pass.
